# @zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox-group

Aggregate of member checkboxes with a DERIVED tri-state and an optional
"select all" master. The group's own all / none / some state is NEVER stored as
an aggregate that can drift from its members -- it is computed on read from the
members' live signals (ADR 0008). A master derives "mixed" when members are
partial; setting the master sets every member.

WAI-ARIA APG: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/

PEER FLOOR (ADR 0008). Each member's record AND its own `createCheckbox` are
allocated at `register()` time -- an imperative call the consumer makes OUTSIDE
any live tracking context / effect. No member signal is lazily allocated inside a
running effect, so the LF-04 zombie-signal class is not reachable and the
lite-signal `^1.2.0` peer floor is NOT raised.

## Quick example

```js
import { createCheckboxGroup } from "@zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox-group";

const group = createCheckboxGroup({
    onChange: (values, reason) => console.log(values),  // array of checked values
});
group.attachMaster(document.querySelector("#select-all"));

const a = group.register("a");
a.checkbox.attachRoot(document.querySelector("#opt-a"));
const b = group.register("b", { defaultChecked: true });
b.checkbox.attachRoot(document.querySelector("#opt-b"));

group.state();  // "mixed"  (one of two checked)
group.value();  // ["b"]
```

## Options

- `disabled?: boolean`  -- group-wide disabled (cascades to members via setAll path)
- `required?: boolean`  -- paints aria-required on the master
- `onChange?: (values, reason) => void`  -- `values` is the derived array of
                                            checked member values

Unknown option keys throw TypeError (did-you-mean); null / non-object rejected;
undefined / no-arg legal.

## API

- `state()` -> "true" | "false" | "mixed"   -- DERIVED (all checked / none / some)
- `value()` -> string[]                      -- array of checked member values
- `disabled()` -> boolean
- `register(value, memberOptions?)` -> `{ checkbox, off }`
    - allocates the member's own `createCheckbox` HERE (never in an effect)
    - `memberOptions`: `defaultChecked`, `defaultIndeterminate`, `disabled`
    - `checkbox` is a full checkbox instance (attach it to DOM yourself)
    - `off()` removes the member, pool-returns its signal nodes (H-12), and bumps
      the group so `state()`/`value()` readers re-derive
- `setAll(checked, reason?)`   -- setChecked on every member
- `setDisabled(bool)`          -- group + every member
- `attachMaster(el)`           -- role=checkbox select-all; paints group state
                                 (aria-checked "true|false|mixed" + data-*);
                                 click / Space flips all-on <-> all-off
- `destroy()`                  -- seals owned signals + destroys every member (H-12)
- `destroyed` (getter), `memberCount` (getter)

## CSS contract

The master gets:
- `aria-checked="true|false|mixed"`  -- painted STRAIGHT from `state()`
- `data-checked`                     -- present when all members checked
- `data-indeterminate`               -- present when partial ("mixed")
- `data-disabled`                    -- present when disabled

Each member paints its own checkbox contract (see `checkbox` llms.txt).

## Custom element wrapper

`import "@zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox-group/element"` registers
`<lite-checkbox-group>`. Members are `[data-checkbox]` with a `value`; the master
is `[data-select-all]`.

```html
<lite-checkbox-group>
    <span data-select-all></span>
    <label><span data-checkbox value="a"></span> Apple</label>
    <label><span data-checkbox value="b" checked></span> Banana</label>
    <label><span data-checkbox value="c" disabled></span> Cherry</label>
</lite-checkbox-group>
```

### Attributes

- `disabled` -- observed; cascades to members
- `required`

### Imperative API on host

`host.setAll(v, reason?)`, `host.setDisabled(v)`; getters `host.value`,
`host.state`, `host.memberCount`.

### Dispatched events

- `valuechange` -- `{ detail: { values, reason } }`

## Comparison

- `radio-group`: one-of-N (single selection). `checkbox-group`: any-of-N, with a
  derived tri-state master. Both aggregate items and expose a group value.
